notes: Summary: Southbridge builds multilingual contact center workflows for retailers across NA/LatAm/EU. Large customer base in Mexico/Brazil. Wants agent-assist + ticket summarization + automated translations that preserve local tone ("usted/tú").
Primary pain: inconsistent translations/tone across channels -> agents rewrite replies; high variance in CSAT when tone wrong (esp. Peru vs Mexico).
POC ask: prove ability to do region+language routing, preserve tone, and survive 10x traffic spikes (BlackFriday-like). They want fallback policies (model-degree or cache) rather than full outage.
Integration: Intercom & Zendesk first, then Salesforce. Need tool-calling for ticket updates, ticket create, knowledge-search, and 'escalate to human' flow.
Quote from Diego (CTO): "We need replies that sound native — not just correct Spanish. If an agent uses 'usted' in Mexico we look unprofessional. Tone matters to retention."
Cost sensitivity: medium. Willing to pay for predictable SLAs (dedicated pools) but wants Optimize to reduce per-token costs via batching/quantization where quality OK.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS, audit logs and EU residency for several enterprise customers. Legal flagged need for 7-year audit retention on ticket metadata.
Operational concern: current provider throttles during promotions. They want clear conversation on graceful degradation: fallback model variants + cached KB answers + per-customer rate limits.
